title: Senior Content Writer
description:
**Job Title:** Senior Content Writer  
**Experience:** 3–5 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Location:** In-Office / On-Site

Job Overview

We are looking for a talented and experienced **Senior Content Writer** who can create engaging, informative, SEO-friendly, and high-quality content across various digital platforms. The ideal candidate should have excellent writing and editing skills, a strong understanding of SEO best practices, and the ability to develop compelling content strategies that align with business goals.

The candidate will be responsible for creating original content, managing content projects, maintaining brand consistency, and ensuring all content meets quality standards while driving organic traffic and audience engagement.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop high-quality, original, and engaging content for websites, blogs, landing pages, articles, and other digital platforms.
* Write SEO-optimized content using relevant keywords, search intent, and on-page SEO best practices.
* Conduct in-depth research on industry trends, topics, competitors, and target audiences.
* Create and execute content strategies to improve website visibility, organic traffic, and audience engagement.
* Edit, proofread, and optimize existing content to ensure accuracy, readability, grammar, and consistency.
* Develop compelling website copy, marketing content, social media content, and promotional materials.
* Collaborate with SEO specialists, digital marketing teams, designers, and other stakeholders.
* Ensure content follows brand guidelines, tone of voice, and communication objectives.
* Monitor content performance and implement improvements based on SEO insights and analytics.
* Manage multiple content projects and meet deadlines without compromising quality.
* Stay updated with the latest SEO trends, content marketing practices, and Google algorithm updates.
* Guide and review content produced by junior writers when required.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 3–5 years of professional content writing experience.
* Excellent command of written English, grammar, vocabulary, and storytelling.
* Strong knowledge of SEO content writing, keyword research, search intent, and content optimization.
* Experience writing long-form articles, blogs, website content, and landing pages.
* Familiarity with SEO tools such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar platforms.
* Ability to conduct independent research and simplify complex topics into reader-friendly content.
* Strong editing, proofreading, and content management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and work within deadlines.
* Familiarity with AI writing tools and the ability to use them effectively while maintaining originality and content quality.

Preferred Skills

* Experience in developing content calendars and content strategies.
* Understanding of technical SEO and content structure.
* Experience in writing content for different industries and target audiences.
* Ability to analyze content performance and suggest data-driven improvements.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on diverse content marketing projects.
* Collaborative and growth-oriented work environment.
* Opportunities for professional development and skill enhancement.
* Competitive salary based on experience and expertise.

Work Location: In person

title: Web Content Writer
description:
* Develop Content Strategies: Formulate and implement comprehensive website and digital content strategies aligned with business, marketing, and SEO goals.

* Write & Craft Core Copy: Produce engaging copy for homepages, service pages, landing pages, product descriptions, thought leadership pieces, and blog networks.

* Maintain Brand Voice: Establish and enforce a consistent brand tone, style guide, messaging framework, and vocabulary across all digital channels.

* Executive & Specialised Writing: Craft high-impact materials such as executive LinkedIn posts, thought leadership articles, press releases, or award submissions.

SEO & Performance Optimization

* Advanced SEO Integration: Apply advanced search engine optimization (SEO), E-E-A-T (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness) principles, search intent mapping, and semantic keyword research.

* On-Page Metadata: Write and optimize compelling meta titles, meta descriptions, headers (H1-H4), and conversion-focused calls-to-action (CTAs).

* Content Auditing & Gaps: Audit existing website pages to update outdated info, improve readability metrics, boost conversion rates, and spot content gaps.

* Analytics Tracking: Analyze content performance metrics, traffic data, and user engagement using analytics tools to refine future topics.

Editing, Quality Control & Team Leadership

* Edit & Proofread: Review, edit, and polish drafts written by junior writers or team members to ensure grammatical precision, clarity, and factual accuracy.

* Mentor & Manage Team: Guide, train, or supervise junior content writers, interns, or external contributors (sometimes managing an in-house content team).

* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with SEO specialists, UI/UX designers, product managers, and digital marketing/campaign leads to meet project deadlines.

* AI & Workflow Integration: Integrate AI tools and Content Management Systems (CMS) like WordPress to streamline research, structure, and publishing workflows

Pay: Up to ₹34,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

title: Documentation Executive
description:
Oriental Compressor Accessories Pvt. Ltd., a trusted name in precision-engineered compressor valves and spare parts for over **60 years**, is looking for a **Documentation Executive** to support our Sales and Operations team. If you're organized, detail-oriented, and enjoy coordinating with customers and internal teams, we'd love to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities

* Handle customer enquiries and prepare accurate, competitive quotations.
* Conduct rate searches and obtain vendor quotations for raw materials, machining, logistics, and outsourced services.
* Prepare costing sheets, compare vendor prices, and maintain pricing databases.
* Coordinate with Sales, Purchase, Production, Design, Stores, and Dispatch teams for quotation preparation and order execution.
* Process customer orders and ensure timely coordination across departments.
* Prepare and maintain quotations, proforma invoices, purchase orders, invoices, dispatch documents, and related commercial documentation.
* Follow up on quotations, customer queries, and order confirmations.
* Maintain accurate documentation, pricing records, and ensure compliance with company standards.

What We're Looking For

**Experience**

* 2–5 years of experience in Documentation, Rate Search, Quotation Preparation, Order Management, Customer Support, or Commercial Operations.

**Education**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* B.Com, BBA, or equivalent qualification preferred.

**Skills**

* Strong documentation and coordination skills.
* Experience in rate searching, vendor price comparison, and quotation preparation.
* Excellent communication and follow-up abilities.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook).
* ERP knowledge will be an added advantage.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and work under deadlines.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
